name: Document picker
plain: System file chooser for one document, such as a resume.
meaning: The app gets only the file picked. Resumes and CVs hold name, address, employers and sometimes IDs.

limits.headline: Can open one document you pick from the system file chooser
limits.user_action: You tap Upload file, Attach, or Choose resume and pick a file
can: Open the one file or files you choose
Upload or attach the file you pick
Let you browse folders, iCloud Drive or other storage in the system chooser
cannot: See other files in the folder that you did not pick
Browse your files itself; the system chooser does the browsing
Keep access after you quit, unless you grant lasting access to that file
Change the file unless the app is allowed to edit it

story.what_it_is: A system window where you pick one file to give to an app.

marketing.name: UIDocumentPickerViewController
marketing.pitch: Developer guide: let people choose documents from iCloud Drive and other providers without giving access to everything.

marketing.name: Storage Access Framework
marketing.pitch: Developer guide: let people pick documents through the system file chooser, with access only to what they choose.

story.for_you: You tap Upload resume and a system file window opens. You pick one file and the app sees only that one. The app cannot browse the other files in the folder.
story.for_makers: Makers avoid asking for broad file access, which keeps trust high and clears store review. They still get the files people need to complete a task.

use_cases.example: A job site lets you upload your resume from iCloud Drive or Google Drive with one tap.
A bank app lets you attach a photo of a check or a PDF statement.
A chat app lets you share a document from any storage provider.
A video editor imports a clip from the Files app into a project.
A school app lets students submit a homework file.
A game with mods lets you import a level file you downloaded.
An expense app lets you attach a receipt PDF from your files.

story.android_note: Uses the system file chooser, with access only to the picked file.
story.ios_note: Uses the system document picker, with access only to the picked file.

legit_uses: Upload a resume for Easy Apply

linkedin.how: Job applications and profile resume uploads use a file chooser. Play Data safety lists Files and docs (optional); Apple label lists Other User Content. Exact picker type is inferred.

refs.label: Android: Open files using the Storage Access Framework
